record.what_it_does: Harvest is a time tracking, invoicing, and expense management tool for freelancers and teams, with a REST API to programmatically manage time entries, projects, clients, invoices, and expenses.
record.auth_notes: Personal Access Tokens (a static bearer token tied to a user, created in the Harvest ID Developers section) are the quickest way to start; OAuth2 (Authorization Code for server-side, Implicit Grant for client-side) is documented for building integrations that other users can authorize. All requests also require an account-specific `Harvest-Account-Id` header and a `User-Agent` header.
record.access_notes: Harvest offers a Free plan ($0 forever, 1 seat/2 projects) as well as a 30-day free trial of paid plans, no credit card required; a developer can create a Personal Access Token immediately from the Developers section of Harvest ID on either.
